name: Ghost of Ramirez DePietro
oracle_text:
Ghost of Ramirez DePietro can't be blocked by creatures with toughness 3 or greater.
Whenever Ghost of Ramirez DePietro deals combat damage to a player, choose up to one target card in a graveyard that was discarded or put there from a library this turn. Put that card into its owner's hand.
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever Ghost of Ramirez DePietro deals combat damage to a player, choose up to one target card in a graveyard that was discarded or put there from a library this turn. Put that card into its owner's hand.

needs.what: a per-turn record, on each card in a graveyard, of how it got there this turn -- discarded from hand, or moved from a library (mill, surveil, any library-to-graveyard move) by any source and any player -- exposed as a selector key for graveyard targets, e.g. `put_into_graveyard_this_turn: {"by": ["discard", "from_library"]}`, so the target is `{"kind": "card", "optional": true, "selector": {"zone": "graveyard", "controller": "any", "put_into_graveyard_this_turn": {...}}}` and the effect a return_to_hand of it. The same record would serve the existing `milled_this_turn` gap (Raul, Tato Farmer, The Master, Transcendent) as the from_library half
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has drawn_this_turn, entered_this_turn and surveilled_this_turn but nothing that reads how or when a card arrived in a graveyard; the value keys cards_discarded_this_turn and cards_to_graveyard_this_turn are only counts, not per-card filters; the ability key arrived_this_turn_from belongs to the play_lands_from_graveyard static, not to target selectors; discard and mill `as` bindings only cover cards moved by that one resolution, not every card discarded or milled this turn by any source
